sentences.text: The documents do not state that Clause 7.4 complies with the RBI’s current rules, because the cited RBI pre-payment rules in force now are not shown in the record and the one potentially relevant current rule has unknown applicability.
Clause 7.4 of the Example UCB Retail Loan Policy v3 is in force and says foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower.
The documents do not state rate_type for the borrower, and R3 says applicability is unknown without borrower and rate_type.

missing.searched: searched the case facts and the RBI rule finding for borrower/rate_type applicability
